name: Astrid Olsen
life: “I still remember my first public painting signed with only my initials.” People around the market by Market Flats know Astrid by a small Tuesday habit. Astrid often waits until the delivery baskets are stacked before going in.
voice: I painted the original under a supervision order. This time I came back on my day off.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a cream pullover and a knotted piece of sail thread on a key ring. Astrid has two dimples that appear only with a full smile, with salt-and-pepper curls. Astrid draws breath as if to speak and lets someone else go first during a conversation.
personality: Astrid loves an audience until a private hurt enters the room. Then the performer disappears and someone very good at getting other people through a door takes over.
agenda: To restore the original only with the neighborhood's agreement.
family: Charles Stone is Astrid’s younger cousin. Astrid makes the call. Charles is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The returned daughter*, Charles says, “I care for the old man. I have no business telling his daughter how frailty ought to make her feel.”
connections: Dario Oh (mural model). The model and the original painter finally explain the sandwich.

reactions.situation: A visitor wants the painted figure made easier to recognize
reactions.response: Astrid asks the original model which part has been misunderstood.

reactions.situation: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off
reactions.response: Astrid offers the worker something dry first and leaves it to them whether to pursue the apology.

reactions.situation: If a stranger asks to hear a private story
reactions.response: Astrid offers one about their own embarrassment instead.
